sobre.title: About me
story: Video has always been my way of telling stories. I started editing at 16, when I created Spencive, my clothing brand. I needed videos to show the pieces, and I learned by doing, from script to final cut.

The brand became my school. I took from it the care of someone who manages and creates content, and the drive to deliver work I'm proud of. That is also where my work as a social media manager began: I plan, create and manage content for fashion, beauty and health brands.
Today I'm a videomaker, editor and social media manager. I shoot and edit vertical video for fashion brands, events and festivals, and I work with clients all over Brazil as a remote editor.
